Reproducing the results involves understanding crystal-field theory, p-d hybridization Hamiltonians, multiplet effects, and proper handling of parameters (Slater integrals, spin-orbit coupling, broadening). The paper provides all parameters, but the agent must correctly interpret and implement them in Quanty, which requires domain knowledge.
